attrs.en: Page 4, week 4, Sourcing finished, purchasing frozen: Our first plan was a sealed growth chamber with hydroponics inside it. Arabidopsis needs steady humidity, temperature and light to give comparable results, and the school lab could not hold any of those steady. The chamber was…
attrs.zh: 第 4 頁，第 4 週，零件尋源完成，採購凍結：我們最初的計畫是一個內含水耕的密閉生長箱。Arabidopsis 需要穩定的濕度、溫度與光照才能得出可比較的結果，而學校實驗室這三項都無法維持穩定。這個生長箱…

attrs.en: Page 5, Sourcing finished, purchasing frozen, continued: DECISION Freeze purchasing instead of building in parallel If half of it was already built we’d have argued to keep going. We hadn’t spent anything yet, so stopping was free. REJECTED Ordering the slow-delivery parts anyway to…
attrs.zh: 第 5 頁，零件尋源完成，採購凍結，續：決策 凍結採購，而不是同時動工 如果已經做了一半，我們大概會主張繼續做下去。當時還沒花任何錢，所以停下來不花成本。否決 仍先訂購交期長的零件，以…

attrs.en: Page 6, week 5, Visiting Prof. Verslues: We had a chamber design nobody had agreed to and a purchasing freeze. None of us had seen a working plant growth setup, so we went to look at one before designing any more of our own. Incubator shelf with vertical agar plates…
attrs.zh: 第 6 頁，第 5 週，拜訪 Prof. Verslues：我們手上有一個沒人同意的生長箱設計，以及一道採購凍結令。我們沒有人看過真正運作中的植物栽培裝置，所以在繼續設計自己的之前，先去看了一套。培養箱層架上直立擺放的瓊脂培養盤…

attrs.en: Page 7, week 6, Told to drop soil sensing: Our original plan was to sense drought stress in soil and release protectant into the soil directly. Before committing to it we wanted someone who sells into agriculture to tell us whether it held up. Meeting in progress…
attrs.zh: 第 7 頁，第 6 週，被告知放棄土壤感測：我們原本的計畫是偵測土壤中的乾旱逆境，並把保護劑直接施放到土壤裡。在正式投入之前，我們想請一位實際在農業市場銷售的人告訴我們這個想法站不站得住腳。會議進行中…

attrs.en: Page 8, week 7, The pivot, and asking Dr. Pak where to start: This is the week the project changed shape. The pivot document went up on 15 April: instead of sensing soil and releasing into it, engineered B. subtilis would live inside a sealed vessel, and light would tell them when to…
attrs.zh: 第 8 頁，第 7 週，轉向，並向 Dr. Pak 請教從何處著手：這一週專題改變了形貌。轉向文件在 4 月 15 日發布：不再偵測土壤並往土壤裡施放，而是讓改造過的 B. subtilis 住在一個密閉容器內，再用光告訴它們何時…

attrs.en: Page 9, week 8, Working out what a stress assay should measure: The pivot had landed but the plant side of the project had no experiment behind it. Before building anything for the plants we needed to agree what stress we would apply, at what level, and what we would measure to say whether…
attrs.zh: 第 9 頁，第 8 週，釐清逆境檢測該量測什麼：轉向已經定案，但專題的植物端還沒有實驗支撐。在為植物製作任何東西之前，我們得先談定要施加什麼逆境、強度多少，以及要量測什麼才能判斷…

attrs.en: Page 10, week 9, Nothing much happened: only the productive weeks misrepresents how the summer actually went. pre WEEK 09 27 APRIL – 3 MAY 2026 A quiet week. Several of us were away. Kept in the record because a notebook containing PROBLEMS HOW WE’LL FIX IT A week lost…
